notes: Which data asset of the ALS pack (G:/DCC/AlsPack/data) each root settings param of the DAL logics takes, where the Blueprint defaults of the pack do not say.

AlsCharacter.dal replaces the Blueprint event SelectMantlingSettings (AlsCharacter_Actions.cpp:577, overridden in B_Als_Character) by one param per data asset and the view select_mantling_settings: High -> MantlingHigh, InAir -> MantlingHighInAir, Low -> MantlingLow, Low with the Box overlay -> MantlingLowBox.

MS_Als_Low_BothHands, MS_Als_Low_Left and MS_Als_Low_Right are chosen by overlay mode in the sample Blueprint; that table is not part of the pack, so the logic does not use them (add a kind, a param and a branch to select_mantling_settings for a project that does).

The Settings / MovementSettings params of AlsCharacter and the Settings param of AlsAnimationInstance are bound from the Blueprint defaults (CS_Als_Default, MS_Als_Normal, AIS_Als_Default): anim_pack.als_bindings.
